description: This course deals with the foundation and applications of statistical inference. Topics include review of statistical decision making, point estimation, hypothesis testing, and linear regression, with emphasis on interpretation and decision-making under uncertainty. The course also introduces foundational data analysis techniques including unsupervised learning (e.g., density estimation, clustering, and PCA) and basic time series modeling. Students will be able to recognise the impact of limited information, select appropriate analytical tools, and to conduct and evaluate simple experiments.
